en.hist.eyebrow: From someone who lives between currencies
en.hist.h2: The app I needed didn't exist. So I built it.
en.hist.p: More and more people have money that doesn't fit in one country: it arrives in different currencies and ends up scattered across accounts at home and abroad. I'm one of those people — and I'm also a developer. The question that kept going unanswered was the most basic one: adding it all up, how much do I really have? No spreadsheet or app answered it without treating one of my currencies as an exception. So I designed the tool that was missing: complete, truly multicurrency, and end-to-end encrypted by architectural decision, not by marketing. Not even I, on the server, can see your numbers. I built it to use — and I stand behind every decision in it.
en.hist.quote: The question was simple: adding it all up, how much do I have?
en.cf.h2: Three steps to see everything in one place.
en.cf.p: No opening a bank account, no linking a card, no handing your data to anyone. You enter it, the app organizes it, and the full picture appears — in the currency you choose.
en.step1.p: Accounts, investments, debts and goals — each item in its own currency. You type it once.
en.step2.h: The exchange rate does the rest
en.step2.p: Currency conversion is automatic (live FX rates), with manual adjustment whenever you want. Real, euro, dollar — your call.
en.step3.p: Net worth, the month's budget, your future projection and your freedom number — all in a clean dashboard that fits your phone and your computer.
en.pn.h2: Simple on the surface. Complete underneath.
en.pn.p: Behind the calm of the dashboard there's real depth. Every number answers a question that keeps you up at night — and answers it in the currency you understand.
en.m2.h: Real, euro, dollar speaking the same language.
en.m2.p: Each item keeps its own currency; you choose which one to see the whole in.
en.m3.p: Income and spending by category, in any currency, with the month's chart on the spot.
en.m4.p: Compound interest + contributions, showing the value down the road and what it's worth in today's money, already adjusted for inflation.
en.m5.h: How you're doing, in one index.
en.m5.p: A ring that sums up the balance of your finances in one simple number.
en.m6.h: BR, US and Europe, side by side.
en.m6.p: The rates that move your money in the places that matter to you.
en.pn.human: All of this so you can sleep easy knowing exactly where you stand.
en.lb.h2: How far are you from being free?
en.lb.p: Your independence number, calculated for real — compound interest, contributions, inflation. In today's money, in the country you choose.
en.fm.h2: The people who matter follow along — without ever moving your privacy out of place.
en.fm.p: When financial life is shared, clarity has to be too. With Family Access, you share a read-only dashboard with someone you trust — partner, parent — through a link and a four-digit PIN. They follow the picture; no one changes a thing. And, true to our rule, it happens without breaking the encryption.
en.fm.badgenote: Sees the dashboard. Doesn't edit, delete or export.
en.fm.guarantee: E2EE intact: the server still can't see your values.
en.pv.h2: Not even we can see your numbers.
en.pv.p: Most apps promise privacy and, deep down, read everything. Here it's different by design: your data is encrypted on your own device, with a key only you have, before it goes anywhere. What reaches our server is an unreadable blur. No tracking, no ads, no selling your behavior. Privacy isn't a feature — it's the foundation.
en.pv.honesty: End-to-end encryption (E2EE). If you lose your password and your recovery code, not even we can recover your data — that's exactly the point.
en.pv.ciphernote: Just this: an encrypted blob. No account name, no balance, no value — not even for us.
en.pillar1.p: Your numbers are scrambled before they leave the device. The server only sees code.
en.pillar2.p: Derived from your password, with a recovery code only you keep. No one else can open it.
en.pillar3.p: You're the user, not the product. We don't sell, don't spy, don't hand it over.
en.ir.h2: When the taxman comes, your numbers are already in order.
en.ir.p: The app pulls your net worth and builds your Assets & Rights document — with codes, descriptions and the two 12/31 columns — ready for your accountant to type in. We don't file it, we don't send anything, we don't compute your tax. We just take the chaos out of the way.
en.ir.l1: Pulls from your net worth. Every asset becomes a line with a suggested code and a ready description.
en.ir.l2: The two 12/31 columns. Prior year and base year, the way the tax office wants — and what you sold during the year lands correctly.
en.ir.l3: Foreign assets, by the book. Acquisition cost at the central-bank rate (PTAX) from the purchase date — the app doesn't make up values.
en.ir.l4: Exports to PDF and spreadsheet — and never leaves your device. Not even we can see your numbers.
en.ir.honesty: This is not your tax return. The app organizes — it doesn't file, doesn't send, doesn't give tax advice. Always check with an accountant.

en.ct.p: Clarity to see everything, privacy to sleep easy, and a community that gets your journey. Come in now, while it's the beginning — and help build the tool you always wished you had.
en.faq.h2: What people usually want to know.
en.faq.a1: The core is free forever: net worth, budget, investments, projection and independence. Pro (optional) unlocks Family Access, the IRPF organizer, the full PDF report and advanced projection — with a 14-day free trial. No card to get started.
en.faq.a2: Yes — sign-up is open and free. It's a new product, still being built: joining now means being among the first and helping shape what's coming.
en.faq.a3: No. Everything is encrypted on your device before it leaves it. What we store is a blur not even we can read.
en.faq.q4: What if I lose my password?
en.faq.a4: You get a recovery code when you sign up — keep it safe. Without the password and that code, not even we can open your data. It's the fair price of real privacy.
en.faq.q5: Which currencies does it work with?
en.faq.a5: Each item keeps its own currency, and you choose which one to see the whole in. Real, euro, dollar and others — with automatic rates and manual adjustment.
en.faq.q6: Do I need to be online?
en.faq.a6: No. The app is local-first: it works instantly and offline, and syncs encrypted when you're back online.
